title: Castellum Vartan(...)
description: An ancient Roman settlement noted by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas) in the vicinity of contemporary "Koudiat Adjela". The fragmentary ancient name was provided by an inscription discovered in 1930 at "Mechta Sidi-Hassem," which has also been reported as "Douar Boutara". The location should lie within 2 km of the BAtlas coordinates: a point just over a kilometer northeast of modern Bir el Kerma.

properties.description: Coordinates extracted using QGIS from a raster image of Barrington Atlas Map 31 that was georegistered to OpenStreetMap using prominent, stable landscape features. Dates after BAltDir.
